proposed_facts.reason: Canonical initialization confirms attribute, facing, retained-owner, velocity and lifetime flow. The actual scaling callee multiplies non-disabled hitcapsule scales.
Successful construction captures the retained owner before initialization; the delegated scale operation targets hitcapsules rather than visual scale.
Creation guard and initialization order match the proposal, including numeric state 0, ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE and the disabled-hitcapsule exception.
The helper has the stated void(Item_GObj*) signature, is directly called by the initializer and is absent from the sole state-table entry.
State entry precedes the retained-owner scale query and hitcapsule multiplication; the scaling callee contains no model mutation.
The local helper has no guard or lifetime update. Its callee iterates four slots, skips disabled capsules and uses multiplication rather than assignment.

The table and callback bodies establish lifetime ticking, empty local physics, integer collision-report OR, constant true combat callbacks and delegated reflection. Deferring dispatcher-consumption semantics is appropriate.

contradictions.reason: Accept the four unresolved section-related dispositions: source confirms zero literals and horizontal velocity initialization but cannot establish .sdata2 attribution, pooling, section size or padding. Compiled evidence remains required.

Accept all six scaling supersessions: model/presentation scaling and scale synchronization are inaccurate descriptions of the delegated operation. The canonical callee multiplies existing scales of non-disabled hitcapsules among four slots.

Accept the callback-semantics supersession: exact local return behavior is supported, whereas dispatcher-side termination semantics are not established by these bodies. The proposal and functionality document consistently preserve that distinction.
